description:
Add a new security to an existing portfolio and record a purchase transaction. A portfolio file with Apple Inc and a $150,000 cash deposit is available at /home/ga/Documents/PortfolioData/growth_portfolio.xml. Open this file in Portfolio Performance if it is not already open.

1. Add a new security with these details:
   - Name: Alphabet Inc Class A
   - Ticker Symbol: GOOGL
   - ISIN: US02079K3059
   - Currency: USD
2. Record a BUY transaction for Alphabet Inc Class A:
   - Date: 2024-03-10
   - Shares: 15
   - Price per share: $140.00 (total value: $2,100.00)
   - Fees: $9.99
   - Securities account: Main Brokerage
   - Cash account: Main Brokerage (USD)
3. Save the portfolio file
